setup.js: (()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=new RegExp("N[\u00e3a]o foi poss[i\u00ed]vel|Erro ao|Tente novamente|indispon[i\u00ed]vel|Algo deu errado|Something went wrong|Falha ao|Pop-up bloqueado|Sem permiss[\u00e3a]o",'i');const ign=new RegExp("$^",'i');const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&!ign.test(m[0])&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);return 1})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const tr=[...document.querySelectorAll('main tbody tr')].find(r=>r.innerText.includes("Radiador de cobre"));if(!tr)return 'SEM ALVO: linha';const b=tr.querySelector('td:last-child button');if(!b)return 'SEM ALVO: botao';b.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,pointerType:'mouse'}));for(let i=0;i<30;i++){const it=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=menuitem]')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==="Excluir");if(it){it.click();return 'ok'}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}return 'SEM ALVO: item'})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const norm=t=>t.replace(/[\s\u00a0]+/g,' ').toLowerCase();const esp=["Radiador de cobre", "Código: 70", "Atenção: Este material possui 110 Kg em estoque."];let out='';for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const els=[...document.querySelectorAll("[role=dialog]")].filter(e=>!false||e.innerText.includes(""));const el=true?els[els.length-1]:els[0];if(!el){out='DIFERENTE: sem elemento';}else{const t=norm(el.innerText);const falta=esp.filter(e=>!t.includes(norm(e)));if(!falta.length)return 'OK: '+esp.join(' | ');out='DIFERENTE: faltou '+JSON.stringify(falta)+' em: '+t.slice(0,260);}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));}return out})()
